mapper.select: SELECT id, public_id, status, starts_at_utc, total_quantity, high_quantity, high_points, normal_points, next_acceptance_sequence, issued_quantity, settings_locked_at, created_at, updated_at, closed_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AS db_now FROM coupon_event WHERE id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_event SET status = 'OPEN', updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{eventId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED'
UPDATE coupon_event SET next_acceptance_sequence = #{nextAcceptanceSequence}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{eventId}

UPDATE coupon_event SET issued_quantity = issued_quantity + 1, status = CASE WHEN issued_quantity >= total_quantity THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE status END, closed_at = CASE WHEN issued_quantity >= total_quantity THEN UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE closed_at END, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{eventId} AND issued_quantity < total_quantity
